title: In, out, up, down: be-, ki-, fel-, le-

sections.title: A small word in front
sections.content: Hungarian puts a short direction word in front of a verb and writes it as one word with it. These are called preverbs. *Be-* means in, *ki-* out, *fel-* up and *le-* down. With *megy* and *jön* they give the four moves you need every day: *bemegy* (goes in), *kijön* (comes out), *felmegy* (goes up), *lejön* (comes down). The person ending stays on the verb: *bemegyek*, *bemész*, *bemegy*.

items.english: I am going into the shop.
Anna goes out into the garden.

sections.content: Watch the spaces. *Ki jön?* in two words asks "Who is coming?", with *ki* as the question word. *Kijön* in one word means "comes out".
